caption: This is a monochromatic pencil drawing of a dress with short puffed sleeves, a high waist, and a long skirt. The dress features embroidery or decorative details on the bodice and the sleeves, which are adorned with floral or dot patterns and a scalloped edge. The neckline is rounded, and the dress is gathered at the waist with another band of gathers at the neckline. The skirt is long and falls straight down with slight folds suggesting soft, light fabric. The hem of the skirt has at least three wide horizontal bands of alternating texture or embroidery, providing decorative detail at the bottom of the garment. The drawing is executed on a plain light background, with the dress rendered primarily in shades of grey graphite. No additional objects or colors are present in the composition.
title: Infant's Dress
